page.overview:
Who is Bolar?

Bolar was a shaman of an unknown race from the city of Kjeld, during the Ice Age of Dominaria.

He was part of Sir Zaraya's band to help the Marked Ones and befriended them during the mission. He recognized the planeswalker Kristina of the Woods when she appeared for Freyalise’s World Spell.

The Ice Age comic's editorial indicated that Bolar was an 'aspiring planeswalker' caught in the Shard of the Twelve Worlds, who had chosen to make his home on Dominaria. His pointed ears and the little arms sticking out from his chest are not explained.
